fields.meta_description: Build a pest control quote form that prices home jobs by square footage, books termite inspections, and routes business requests. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Pest Control Quote Form That Prices the Job
fields.hero_description: Get a pest control quote form that shows homeowners a price on submit and sends termite and business jobs to the right person.
fields.explore_cta: Build My Pest Control Quote Form
fields.features_heading: A Quote Request That Arrives Ready to Price
fields.features_subheading: Emergent builds the form, the price tiers behind it, and the routing that puts termite and business jobs in front of a person.
fields.feature_1:
Questions that start with the pest

Customers pick the pest first, then say where in the building they saw it and upload a photo if they have one. Picking termites swaps the price for an inspection booking.
fields.feature_2:
A price drawn from square footage

Set a first-visit price for each square footage tier you quote. A homeowner sees the price for their tier on screen before submitting, so the phone call opens on a number.
fields.feature_3:
Photos of the pest or the damage

An optional upload takes a picture of droppings, mud tubes, or a wasp nest. The technician opens the request and sees the photo beside the address before driving out.
fields.feature_4:
Commercial jobs reach a person

Choose Business as the property type and the form shows no price. Instead it emails the request to the person who writes commercial contracts, who quotes for that building.
fields.feature_5:
Reminders on quotes nobody answered

Pick how many days a quote can sit unanswered. Past that point the customer gets one email reminder, and the owner gets a short list of every quote that was nudged that day.
fields.feature_6:
Requests in a database you own

Every request lands as a row in a database you own, with the pest, the address, and the price shown. On paid plans, export the full code to your own GitHub repository.

fields.hero_prompt: Build a pest control quote form for my extermination company where customers pick the pest, enter their square footage, and see a first-visit price.

faq_plan.q: What is a pest control quote form?
How do I create a pest control quote form?

plan.angle: Searches for pest control quote form come from exterminators who want quote requests that arrive ready to price; template pages stop at a list of contact fields. This page shows one form that prices a home job from square footage on submit, holds the price for termites until an inspection, sends business requests to the person who writes commercial contracts, and reminds customers about quotes still open after 5 days. The field set stays the same throughout: property type, square footage, the pest, where it was seen, and an optional photo.
tab_stories: At Pikeshore Pest Control, Zebulon Lowrie reports ants in the kitchen of his 1,800 sq ft home and sees a $129 first-visit price before he submits, because homes under 2,000 sq ft fall in the first tier.

At Wrenfield Termite and Pest, Isadora Quint picks termites and attaches a photo of mud tubes on her garage wall, so the form shows no price and books an inspection with Corwin Baptiste for Thursday at 2:00 PM.

At Briarlock Pest Services, the Tamarind Row Bistro picks Business, enters 3,400 sq ft and fruit flies at the bar drains, and the request goes by email to commercial manager Tamsin Vell instead of showing a price.
At Ottery Exterminating, 14 quotes are open, the 4 still open after 5 days each get one email reminder, and owner Nell Ashcombe gets the list of those 4 by email.
